lightdamage.def: Arc, Solar or Void damage. Prismatic fragments and Transcendence track it separately from Darkness damage.

darknessdamage.def: Stasis or Strand damage. Prismatic fragments and Transcendence track it separately from Light damage.

lightability.def: Any Arc, Solar or Void grenade, melee, class ability or Super.
lightability.q: Light abilities deal 10% increased damage to enemies affected by Stasis or Strand elemental debuffs.

transcendenceenergy.def: The Light and Darkness meters that fill as you deal damage and apply elemental effects; when both are full you can become Transcendent.
transcendenceenergy.q: Dealing damage, alongside applying Elemental Effects grants Transcendence Energy.

prismaticgrenade.def: The class-specific grenade that replaces your grenade while Transcendent, dealing both Light and Darkness damage (Electrified Snare, Hailfire Spike, Freezing Singularity).
prismaticgrenade.q: Replaces Grenade Ability with an unique class-specific Prismatic Grenade Ability with Light and Darkness damage types.

damageresistance.def: Reduces the damage you take from enemies.
damageresistance.q: Grants 15% [?%] Damage Resistance while within 15 meters of 3 enemies.
